answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, since each one must be independent on the vault graph and each exposes its bond to the beacon slash if it rubber-stamps. A verdict only settles when 4 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. Since disagreement burns everyone the epoch, the hollow audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
